name: Pancake's Wall Hop Difficulty Chart
desc:
Welcome to Pancakes Wallhop Difficulty chart!

[Update 1.21!] Chat Features Update!
- Chat has been updated to include translation with roblox supported languages
- New overhead chat name and tags, with coloured bubbles

📝Check out the entire update log here: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/1380845

Shutdown = UPDATE/BUG FIX

Wallhopping is a glitch in Roblox that this game takes advantage of, to create an obby with increasing difficulty as you progress! If you do not know how to wallhop, there are many YouTube videos with great explanations!

📈 Your progress saves, so you can take a break and come back later!

⭐Current stages: 93!

⚠️ All stages have been tested and are possible!

💀 Press R to reset!

🎁 Join the community server for giveaways! 

👉Join our group to get notified about game updates! https://www.roblox.com/groups/5728104/CanPan-Studios#!/about
